summary: Starved trees grow strongest Abundance keeps roots from growing deep disconnected in soul and soil untethered to her healing ways While trees versed in denial withstand tall trials stability brought by Pain healing tears of wood and bark carried on winds of inequity #poemsofpresence
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Starved trees
grow strongest

Abundance
keeps roots from
growing
deep

disconnected
in soul and
soil
untethered to her
healing ways

While trees
versed in denial
withstand tall
trials

stability
brought by Pain

healing
tears of wood and
bark
carried on winds
of inequity

#poemsofpresence
